channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O que diz Eduardo Bolsonaro sobre sua atuação nos EUA para financiar ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied involvement in the financial management of the film Dark Horse and explained that transfers from banker Daniel Vorcaro were made via Entre Investimentos e Participações to the Havengate Development Fund LP in Texas, USA, to avoid 'persecution' of the production due to Brazil's political climate. He stated the fund is in the U.S. because producing the film in Brazil would not be feasible given what he describes as a hostile regime toward the right. The production company Goup Entertainment denied any involvement of Vorcaro or his companies in the film's financing.

item.title: Requião ataca privatizações de Ratinho Jr. e vê direita enfraquecida no Paraná
item.description: Roberto Requião (PDT), former governor of Paraná and pre-candidate for federal deputy, harshly criticized the privatization of state-owned companies like Copel and Sanepar under Governor Ratinho Junior (PSD), accusing him of favoring large economic groups and turning the state into a 'negotiation'. He also stated that the scandal involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and businessman Daniel Vorcaro has definitively weakened right-wing candidacies in Paraná, impacting allies such as Bolsonaro and Sérgio Moro (PL), whom he accused of being complicit in the privatizations.

item.title: Eduardo controlou orçamento do filme de Bolsonaro, diz site
item.description: Former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro signed on as executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse', which chronicles his father Jair Bolsonaro’s life, with direct budgetary control per a January 2024 contract disclosed by Intercept Brasil. Funding came partially from Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, and Eduardo claims he used R$350,000 raised via his platform Ação Conservadora to seed the project in the U.S. The Federal Police are investigating whether Vorcaro’s funds were used for Eduardo’s personal expenses in the U.S. and to finance an international political support network for the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: TCU é acionado para investigar financiamento de filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Subprosecutor Lucas Rocha Furtado of the MPTCU requested the TCU to investigate the financing of the film Dark Horse, depicting Jair Bolsonaro's life, over suspicions of indirect use of public funds and contributions from Banco Master via Entre Investimentos, including possible concealment of fund origins and links to money laundering suspicions.

item.title: Eduardo nega ter recebido dinheiro de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied receiving money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, accusing Intercept Brasil of conducting a selective leak to target his family. He defended his brother Flávio Bolsonaro’s reputation and rejected claims that he is being financially supported by Vorcaro in the United States. The statement was posted on his X account on Friday, the 15th.

item.title: Filme retrata ‘neura de perseguição’ de Bolsonaro e trata Lula com citações
item.description: The film Dark Horse portrays Jair Bolsonaro up to his presidency, featuring real-life characters in a fictionalized depiction. The production is controversial due to sponsorship by Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, who is imprisoned on charges of money laundering and corruption. Lula appears only through archival footage and dialogue references, without interacting as a character, being cited as a figure of suspicion by Bolsonaro during his post-stabbing recovery.

item.title: PGR denuncia ao STJ Romeu Zema por calúnia contra ministro Gilmar Mendes
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office denounced Romeu Zema to the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) for defamation against Minister Gilmar Mendes, following the dissemination of a social media video portraying the minister as a puppet and falsely accusing him of passive corruption. The PGR argued the content exceeds permissible criticism and constitutes the crime of slander under Article 138 of the Penal Code, as it falsely imputes a criminal act. The case originated from a request by Minister Gilmar Mendes to investigate Zema in the Fake News inquiry, which was referred to the STJ due to the public office connection.

item.title: TSE mobiliza logística para eleição suplementar em Roraima
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and the Regional Electoral Court of Roraima (TRE-RR) are mobilizing logistical support, including from the Armed Forces, to conduct the supplementary election for governor and vice-governor of Roraima on June 21, 2026. The election was called following the cassation of the incumbent state executive’s mandate. Due to geographic isolation and climatic challenges, over half of Roraima’s territory — composed of indigenous lands and accessible only via waterways or airstrips in conservation status — requires a complex operation to ensure voting access.

item.title: A mensagem que aparece no final do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The content describes a final scene in a film about Bolsonaro, where a lettering message states that an investigation concluded the assassin acted alone, but the inquiry was incomplete and left out many questions. It then notes that Bolsonaro lost re-election in 2022 by a narrow margin, faced allegations of electoral fraud, and saw mostly peaceful protests across Brazil, although many were arrested. Finally, it claims that in 2025, Bolsonaro was accused of attempting a coup, convicted, and sentenced to 43 years in prison by the STF.

item.title: Ibovespa recua e dólar volta aos R$ 5 de olho em geopolítica internacional
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 0.61% and the dollar closed above R$5, reflecting risk aversion amid political uncertainty following a scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro. Banks led losses in the index, with Itaú, Bradesco, and Santander declining. Internationally, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, potential Iranian nuclearization, and the Federal Reserve leadership change — Jerome Powell replaced by Kevin Warsh — heightened global inflation concerns.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro teve postura idêntica à de Toffoli ao esconder por 6 meses relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro initially denied receiving money from Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, but after six months of silence and upon being confronted with evidence by The Intercept, he admitted the truth, citing a confidentiality agreement. His conduct was likened to that of Minister Dias Toffoli, who concealed his ties to the vorcárica network while serving as rapporteur of the case at the STF, revealing a pattern of omission and collusion between officials and private interests linked to suspected money laundering.

item.title: Subprocurador pede que TCU apure financiamento de filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The subprosecutor-general of the MP alongside the TCU, Lucas Furtado, requested an investigation into possible irregular use of public resources in the financing of the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, citing evidence of funds from Banco Master and concealment of the resource origins. The request is based on Intercept Brasil reports revealing dialogues between Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, concerning demands for million-dollar investments in the film. Furtado highlights inconsistencies in the denials by Deputy Mário Frias and Go Up Entertainment, which initially denied Vorcaro's contributions.

item.title: Dólar sobe 1,6%; Bolsa tem maior queda semanal desde início da guerra
item.description: The dollar rose 1.63% to close at R$ 5,067, gaining 3.54% for the week, while the Ibovespa fell 0.61% in the session and 3.14% weekly — its biggest drop since the start of the U.S.-Iran conflict. Market movements were driven by revelations that Flávio Bolsonaro negotiated R$ 134 million with Daniel Vorcaro to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro, alongside new attacks on vessels near the Strait of Hormuz affecting global oil supply, which pushed Brent crude up 3.41%. The scenario reflects currency pressure and risk aversion in domestic markets.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Eduardo Bolsonaro tinha poder sobre orçamento de ‘Dark Horse’, aponta site
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, served as executive director of the biopic 'Dark Horse', according to The Intercept Brasil, giving him control over the film's budget. The Papo Antagonista discusses the implications of such family influence in cultural projects tied to the Bolsonaro clan. The report raises questions about the use of public or private funds in politically biased productions.

item.title: Denúncias da PF contra Castro são consistentes
item.description: The Federal Police alleges that former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro acted to favor the Refit group, led by businessman Ricardo Magro, through strategic high-level appointments, tailored legislation, and using the state’s Finance Secretariat as an extension of the group’s corporate structure. The accusations emerged from Operation Sem Refino, investigating fuel sector fraud, and come less than two months after Castro’s resignation and declaration of ineligibility by the TSE.

item.title: Gilmar diz que Fachin “não sabe perder” e obstrui julgamentos
item.description: Justice Gilmar Mendes criticized Supreme Court President Edson Fachin for repeatedly delaying high-impact rulings, accusing him of employing a 'filibuster' tactic and being less gracious in defeat than his predecessor, Luís Roberto Barroso. Fachin defended his approach, stating he seeks consensus in setting the agenda and views a judicial code of conduct as a central pillar of his presidency, despite Gilmar’s opposition to debating such rules during an election year. The dispute exposed internal tensions over agenda control and ethical governance within the Court.

item.title: Flávio diz confiar “100%” em Eduardo Bolsonaro e Mário Frias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said he trusts '100%' his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro and deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) following revelations about the funding of Jair Bolsonaro’s biopic. He defended Eduardo, stating he used a 'legal platform' to secure the screenwriter Silas, and claimed investors avoid Bolsonaro-linked projects due to fear of persecution by a 'weaponized' Federal Police under Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Crusoé: O plano de Eduardo e Mario Frias para lucrar com ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Intercept Brasil revealed documents showing former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro as executive producer and financier of the film 'Dark Horse' (formerly 'Captain of the People'), with a plan to raise funds by offering 40% stake to investors. Former Culture Secretary Mario Frias is also implicated, suggesting the use of political influence for private profit in a cinematic project aligned with Bolsonarist narratives.

item.title: Flávio diz que 'fica inviável' ter Zema como vice após críticas sobre áudio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that criticisms from former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) regarding an alleged audio recording make it unfeasible for Zema to serve as his running mate in the 2026 presidential ticket.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro nega ter mentido sobre ligação com Vorcaro: 'Não tem nada para me pegar'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, denied having lied when he stated he did not request money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, saying 'there's nothing to get me on' during a CNN Brasil interview. He reiterated his innocence amid allegations of a kickback scheme involving campaign financing.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema se precipitou ao criticar áudio para Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) for acting hastily in publicly commenting on audio messages in which Flávio asked banker Daniel Vorcaro for funds to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. Flávio said Zema should have contacted him first and suggested Zema tried to exploit the situation for electoral gain, arguing that the opposition’s 2026 presidential candidate should be chosen through dialogue among parties.

item.title: Fachin vota com Mendonça e empata julgamento sobre monitoramento de jornalistas e parlamentares
item.description: Minister Edson Fachin voted with André Mendonça to reject the Green Party's action challenging the Bolsonaro government's social media monitoring of journalists and lawmakers, resulting in a 4-4 tie at the Supreme Court. Ministers Luiz Fux, Nunes Marques, and Gilmar Mendes have yet to vote, with the virtual plenary session expected to conclude this Friday.

item.title: PF transfere investigação do escândalo do INSS para outra coordenação, e André Mendonça pede explicações
item.description: The Federal Police transferred the INSS scandal investigation from the General Coordination for Repression of Tax Crimes to the General Coordination for Repression of Corruption, Financial Crimes and Money Laundering (CGRC), specifically to the Cinq team operating within the STF. The move followed a request for explanations from Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, though the PF insists it was purely bureaucratic, with no change in investigators or impact on the probe. The investigation continues to examine the bank accounts of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) for evidence of alleged monthly R$ 300,000 payments from lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes.

item.title: Petrobras anuncia pacote de R$ 37 bilhões para São Paulo, com nova fronteira no pré-sal e expansão no Porto de Santos
item.description: Petrobras announced a R$ 37 billion investment package for São Paulo from 2026 to 2030, highlighting the exploration of the new pre-salt area 'Arã', expansion at the Port of Santos, and advances in refining and biofuels. The package underscores the state's strategic importance to the company and comes during an election year, with President Lula planning a visit to the Replan refinery in Paulínia alongside Petrobras President Magda Chambriá.

item.title: “Ficou maravilhoso, vocês vão gostar”, diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre filme biográfico do pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for presidency from the PL party, praised the biographical film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro, saying it is ready and will restore the ex-president’s honor. He made the remarks during a visit to a Military Police battalion in Rio de Janeiro, where he was met with protests and shouts of 'bandit' and 'catch the thief'. Flávio also referenced overdue payments related to the film 'Dark Horse', involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is detained on charges of financial fraud, money laundering, and organized crime.

item.title: Eduardo assinou contrato como produtor-executivo de filme sobre Bolsonaro, diz site
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro signed a contract as executive producer of the film 'Dark Horse', about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, according to documents obtained by The Intercept Brasil. The contract grants him authority over the project’s financial management, contradicting his public statements that he had only licensed his image rights and held no managerial role in the production.

item.title: Fux defende decisão de Toffoli e mantém a extinção de processos contra Beto Richa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux rejected a motion from the Paraná Public Prosecutor’s Office and upheld Justice Dias Toffoli’s decision to dismiss four criminal cases against federal deputy Beto Richa, calling the action 'manifestly unfounded' based on STF precedent. Fux emphasized that remedies must be pursued through proper legal channels or rescissory action, not via mandamus against justices. The ruling reaffirms Toffoli’s 2023 decision annulling Lava Jato-related acts against Richa due to alleged collusion between prosecution and defense.

item.title: Flávio dá nova versão sobre contatos com Vorcaro e agora admite que pode haver vídeo enviado ao banqueiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) admitted that new records of contact with banker Daniel Vorcaro may emerge, including a possible video he may have sent, after previously downplaying the likelihood of further developments in the 'Dark Horse' film case. He stated all interactions were solely related to the film about former President Jair Bolsonaro and denied there was anything to hide. The remarks follow allies expressing surprise and irritation over the leaked audio in which he sought financial support from Vorcaro, prompting the pre-campaign to convene an emergency meeting.

item.title: Eduardo tinha poder sobre o orçamento de filme de Bolsonaro, diz ‘Intercept’
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro allegedly had control over the budget of the film 'Dark Horse', according to The Intercept, based on a 2024 contract naming him as executive producer with direct financial oversight, contradicting his prior claim of no managerial role. Flávio Bolsonaro stated that funds from Daniel Vorcaro, the former Banco Master CEO jailed for a billion-dollar fraud, were transferred to a fund managed by Eduardo’s lawyer, and said Eduardo will explain the matter in an upcoming social media video.

item.title: Fora do STF, Barroso participa de fórum em Oxford e diz o que ainda precisa mudar no Brasil
item.description: Former STF President Luís Roberto Barroso participated in the Brazil-UK Forum at the University of Oxford, highlighting Brazil's strengths such as agribusiness, PIX, Embraer, electronic voting machines, and advances in human rights for women, Black people, LGBTQIAPN+ individuals, and indigenous peoples. He also identified ongoing challenges, including the weak fight against violence and organized crime, the need for electoral reform (advocating for mixed-district voting since 2006), and corruption, noting Brazil ranks 107th in Transparency International's Corruption Perceptions Index. Barroso also joined a panel on artificial intelligence.

item.title: Quase 70% dos posts sobre escândalo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro reprovam o senador
item.description: A Nexus survey shows that 65% of the 3,000 most engaged posts about the scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro contain negative evaluations of the senator's image, while 35% are neutral. The episode has become a digital crisis for the Bolsonaro clan, marked by strong rejection on social media. The full report is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro dará palavra final sobre candidatura de Cláudio Castro ao Senado pelo PL; entenda
item.description: Cláudio Castro's Senate candidacy for the PL faces new hurdles following a Federal Police investigation into alleged tax fraud involving the Refit Group, compounded by his 2030 ineligibility due to a TSE ruling. While some allies suggest maintaining his candidacy pending further investigation, internal PL pressure favors alternatives such as Carlos Jordy, Carlos Portinho, or even Felipe Curi of the PP. The final decision rests with the Bolsonaro clan, with Portinho already expressing interest in running for re-election.

item.title: José Dirceu é diagnosticado com linfoma após internação, diz hospital
item.description: José Dirceu, former Chief of Staff and PT founding figure, has been diagnosed with lymphoma at age 80 and is hospitalized in good clinical condition at Sírio-Libanês Hospital. His return to politics in 2026 as a federal deputy candidate for São Paulo aims to support Lula’s re-election and strengthen Fernando Haddad’s gubernatorial campaign, with the goal of reducing Tarcísio de Freitas’ electoral advantage.

item.title: Campeões mundiais avaliam chances de convocação de Neymar para a Copa: 'Tem que saber se ele quer ir', diz Rivellino
item.description: Brazilian world champions discussed Neymar's potential call-up for the 2026 World Cup, stressing that his inclusion depends on his willingness to return to the national team. Rivellino praised Neymar's talent but questioned his commitment, while Cafu and Taffarel emphasized focusing on squad quality and team performance, regardless of Neymar's presence.

item.title: José Dirceu é diagnosticado com linfoma após internação em São Paulo
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT-SP) was diagnosed with lymphoma after being hospitalized at Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo. Despite the diagnosis, he is in stable clinical condition and plans to continue his campaign for the Chamber of Deputies, starting chemotherapy this weekend and relying on virtual events and live streams. Dirceu, who turned 80 in March at a political event that included a campaign jingle, said he will 'win this battle too'.

item.title: A voz do povo é a voz de Deus? O que a Central do Brasil pensa sobre convocação de Neymar para Copa; assista
item.description: Neymar Jr. is being debated for a potential call-up by Carlo Ancelotti for the 2026 World Cup, following recent consistent performances for Santos FC, including eight appearances in the last ten matches and three goals. GLOBO surveyed commuters at Rio’s Central do Brasil subway station on whether Neymar should be selected, as he faces a final match against Coritiba to impress the coach before the roster is announced.

item.title: Debates: Renan chama Flávio de “covarde”; senador nega ausência
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party and MBL member, called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) a 'coward' after claiming the senator conditioned his participation in presidential debates on Renan Santos' absence. Flávio Bolsonaro denied the accusation and stated there are no restrictions on his participation in debates with Santos.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto apresenta queixa-crime contra Ricardo Salles no STF
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL party, filed a criminal complaint against federal deputy Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) at the STF for slander and defamation, following Salles' podcast remark that 'Valdemar's group was the one stealing in the Ministry of Transport and DNIT' during Dilma's government. Valdemar's defense claims he was never criminally prosecuted for the alleged facts. Salles left the PL in 2024 after failing to gain support for a São Paulo mayoral bid.

item.title: Governo Lula discute proposta para limitar penduricalhos de servidores públicos
item.description: The Lula government is discussing a legislative proposal at the Ministry of Management to limit 'penduricalhos' — bonuses that allow some public servants to earn above the constitutional salary cap of R$ 46,366.19. The measure aims to reduce income inequality within the public sector and strengthen fiscal discipline. The proposal is still under debate, with no final details on its structure or voting timeline.

item.title: PT faz pesquisa e vai medir impacto de denúncia contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT will conduct an internal survey with Vox next week to measure the impact of allegations against Flávio Bolsonaro on the electoral landscape nationwide. The study will also assess whether Lula’s image improved following the end of the controversial 'shirt tax' issue.

item.title: Flávio ironiza ataque de Zema: ‘mineiro tem mais calma na hora de falar’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro mocked former governor Romeu Zema, calling him 'hasty' for criticizing his request for funding from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, saying miners usually speak more calmly. Flávio said he unsuccessfully tried to call Zema on Thursday and defended the conversation as a 'private investment', while Zema called it 'unforgivable'. The exchange sparked tension within the Novo party and raised doubts about potential alliances with the PL.

item.title: ‘Não tem que justificar nada’, diz Flávio sobre pedido de dinheiro a Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro said he does not need to justify requesting R$135 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about his father Jair Bolsonaro's life. He claimed the funds were private sponsorship and fully used for the movie, although part of the payment was routed through a U.S.-based fund managed by the lawyer of Eduardo Bolsonaro. The revelation threatens his presidential pre-candidacy, which had been polling ahead of Lula in several scenarios.

item.title: 'Não se justifica mais': Tebet defende fim da taxa das blusinhas em ano eleitoral
item.description: Simone Tebet defended the end of the 20% tax on international purchases up to $50, stating the measure, in place for two years, was necessary to organize the Federal Revenue and combat tax evasion, but is no longer justified. She emphasized the tax aimed to protect Brazilian industry from unfair competition and ensure product safety via agencies like Anvisa and Inmetro. The remarks were made at the 3rd Women in Politics Forum in Limeira, São Paulo.

item.title: Crusoé: PF é cobrada por ‘vazamento seletivo’ de dados de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy José Medeiros (PL-MT) filed an information request in the Chamber of Deputés demanding explanations from the Ministry of Justice regarding alleged selective leaking of confidential data related to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and the 'Master' case. The lawmaker questions the disclosure of audios, documents, and investigative elements that may constitute a breach of official secrecy.

item.title: Ala do PL do Rio vê Castro mais frágil, mas descarta abandono imediato
item.description: A faction of Rio de Janeiro's PL supports maintaining backing for former governor Cláudio Castro despite his ineligibility by the TSE and being a target of PF's Operation Sem Refino, arguing that wounded soldiers should not be abandoned. Another faction believes abandonment is inevitable but contingent on Flávio Bolsonaro's agreement, the PL's presidential pre-candidate. Altineu Cortês, Carlos Jordy, and Sóstenes Cavalcante are mentioned as potential replacements in the state race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reforça equipe para responder a ‘situação de estresse’ após conversa com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign is restructuring its communications team after leaked conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro revealed requests for funding to finance a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The move aims to strengthen crisis response and counter misinformation, with new hires led by Marcello Lopes and Victor Martins. The Intercept Brasil and Estadão confirmed the authenticity of messages discussing up to US$ 24 million in contributions, with payments already made through 2025.

item.title: Lula ironiza apoio do Master a filme sobre Bolsonaro: ‘Neste hospital não tem dinheiro do Vorcaro’
item.description: President Lula (PT) mocked financial support from Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro for a Bolsonaro-themed film, stating 'this hospital has no Vorcaro money'. During an event in Barretos (SP), he announced R$ 2.2 billion in health investments, including new funding tables for high-cost oncology drugs and robotic cancer surgeries in the public health system. Lula avoided naming Flávio Bolsonaro but indirectly referenced the alleged R$ 61 million contribution reported by The Intercept Brasil.

item.title: PF troca chefia de caso que envolve INSS e Lulinha; Mendonça e oposição cobram explicações
item.description: The Federal Police changed the leadership of the investigations in Operation Sem Desconto, which probes a fraud scheme involving the INSS and led to the lifting of secrecy on Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. The change followed demands for explanations from the opposition and Senator Sergio Moro, who called for greater transparency in the probe.

item.title: Governo investe R$ 2,2 bi em tratamentos oncológicos no SUS
item.description: President Lula announced a R$ 2.2 billion investment to expand access to oncology treatments through the Unified Health System (SUS), including 23 high-cost drugs and robotic surgeries, benefiting 112,000 patients. The funding covers 18 cancer types, with ten drugs procured directly by the Ministry of Health and the rest distributed via Ambulatory Procedure Authorization, plus R$ 50 million for prostate robotic surgery and R$ 27.4 million annually for breast reconstruction.

item.title: Bolsonaristas veem Tarcísio distante e querem apoio maior a Flávio
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas drew criticism from Bolsonaro supporters for appearing distant amid the controversy involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. Bolsonaro-aligned activists in São Paulo expected stronger public backing for Flávio, viewing the situation as a test of loyalty to the movement.
